title: LinkedIn Jobs Scraper
description: Extract comprehensive job listings from LinkedIn with detailed information including titles, companies, locations, salaries, and full descriptions.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Job title or keywords to search on LinkedIn Jobs.

location.title: Location
location.description: Geographic location (e.g., United States, Germany, Remote).

timeRange.title: Posted time filter
timeRange.description: Limit results to when jobs were posted.

maxJobs.title: Max jobs
maxJobs.description: Maximum number of jobs to collect.

collectOnly.title: Collect only (no details)
collectOnly.description: Collect job URLs only and push minimal items (fast sanity mode).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Select proxies to be used by the crawler (Apify Proxy recommended).
